en: One reading core for every device; the 8,105 core is a download
Fixes the data-pack update fetching the wrong core
Font-extras pack names no longer show missing glyphs
Data packs are now published under their real file names
No functional changes to reading, PDF or apps
zh: 两设备统一阅读核心；8,105 改为可选下载
修复仅更新数据包时取错核心的问题
扩展字体包名不再出现缺字方框
数据包按真实文件名发布
阅读、PDF 与应用功能无变化
